findings.evidence: `CodeTransport.lean` already imports both `Coding` and `Measure/Measurability`, defines `probabilityMeasureCodeMap`, and repeatedly uses the same composite `measurable_probabilityMeasureCode.comp (measurable_probabilityMeasure_map hf)`.
findings.fix: Move both declarations to `CodeTransport.lean`, remove the new `Measurability` import from `Coding.lean`, and import `CodeTransport` wherever the moved API is needed.
findings.issue: `probabilityMeasureCode_map_apply` and `measurable_probabilityMeasureCode_map` belong in `ProbabilityMeasure/CodeTransport.lean`, whose stated topic is transport of canonical codes along measurable maps; placing them here also adds an avoidable `Measurability` dependency to the base coding module.

summary: The new generic pushforward/code lemmas are placed in the base coding module despite an existing module dedicated to code transport.
